# Cost (in cents) of a group of n different books.
# One copy of any book costs $8.00 = 800 cents, with discounts of
# 5%, 10%, 20% and 25% for groups of 2, 3, 4 and 5 different books.
GROUP_PRICES = {1: 800, 2: 1520, 3: 2160, 4: 2560, 5: 3000}


def total(basket):
    # Count copies of each of the five books, most numerous first.
    counts = sorted([basket.count(i) for i in range(1, 6)], reverse=True)

    # Form the largest possible groups, taking one copy of each of the
    # most numerous titles until a title runs out.
    n5 = min(counts)
    counts = [c - n5 for c in counts]
    n4 = min(counts[:4])
    counts = [c - n4 for c in counts]
    n3 = min(counts[:3])
    counts = [c - n3 for c in counts]
    n2 = min(counts[:2])
    counts = [c - n2 for c in counts]
    n1 = counts[0]

    # A group of five plus a group of three costs 3000 + 2160 = 5160,
    # but the same eight books as two groups of four cost 2560 * 2 = 5120.
    # So convert as many (five, three) pairs into pairs of fours.
    swapped = min(n5, n3)
    n5 -= swapped
    n3 -= swapped
    n4 += 2 * swapped

    return (
        n5 * GROUP_PRICES[5]
        + n4 * GROUP_PRICES[4]
        + n3 * GROUP_PRICES[3]
        + n2 * GROUP_PRICES[2]
        + n1 * GROUP_PRICES[1]
    )
